name: QrVersionInfo
src_typeComment: Capacity/EC tables for versions 1-4 at Error Correction Level M only (ISO/IEC 18004 Table 9) — deliberately bounded scope (versions 1-4 cover up to 78 alphanumeric / 62 byte characters, comfortably enough for a URL or short kiosk message) rather than implementing the full version 1-40 x 4-EC-level matrix, since each additional version/level needs its own verified capacity+block-count entry and the risk of a transcription error compounds with every entry added.

src_members.sig: public readonly int Size; // modules per side
src_members.name: Size

src_members.sig: public readonly int DataCodewordsPerBlock; // uniform across all blocks — true for versions 1-4 at level M
src_members.name: DataCodewordsPerBlock

src_members.sig: public static QrVersionInfo Get(int version) => Table[version - 1]
src_members.name: Get
SmallestVersionFor
src_members.comment: Picks the smallest version (1-4) whose data capacity fits the given number of bits, or -1 if even version 4 isn't big enough.
